core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jabri is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Of Jabr; belonging to Jabr”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jabri corresponds to the Arabic form جبري (Nisba of جَبْر; جَبْرِيّ (Jabriyy)). Its core sense is jabri; of jabr, belonging to jabr. Jabri is Arabic جَبْرِيّ (Jabriyy), the nisba of جَبْر (Jabr), meaning 'of Jabr; belonging to Jabr'. The source gloss 'Firm, steadfast' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
